source: BIG-IP 21.1.0.1 build 0.0.26 rule loader (mcpd), 2026-11-20; commands and events from /usr/local/www/docs/irule/irule-schema.json
method: scripts/dev/bigip-probes/open-questions/evmatrix.py: bare command name inside if {0} {...} in when EVENT; verdict from the loader's context message
